title: HalatRuqaa
description: Where a patch stands, from a contributor's draft to a published release.

oneOf.description: A local draft, resumable, visible to nobody else.
Submitted and waiting in the owner's queue.
Returned for revision, with a written summary and anchored comments.
Approved; the publishing sequence is running.
Published and fetchable by every client.
Published and then revoked, and being uninstalled from clients that already have it.
